description: Split a text (for example an AI-generated answer) into atomic factual claims. Each claim includes span, grounding_required, claim_type (number|date|quantity|quote|named_entity_fact|comparison|opinion|prediction|other), check_worthiness (high|medium|low), and the source sentence. Hedges are stripped, pronouns are resolved across sentences, and compound sentences are split. Questions, greetings, opinions and predictions are marked grounding_required false. Up to 3 checkable factual claims (opinions skipped) get a next_step: a ready-to-send quick_check request ($0.15, fast verdict with 1-2 sources), with deep_verify ($0.75) and verify_claim ($1.00) bodies in next_step.alternatives, so you can check them in one more call. Price: $0.05 USDC on Base per call via x402; this MCP call returns payment instructions and POST /v1/extract_claims returns the claims. Read-only.

text.description: The text to split into claims, for example a chatbot answer. Up to a few thousand characters.
examples: The Eiffel Tower is in Paris and was completed in 1889.

next_step.description: Present only on unsure or low-confidence claims (check_answer) or unverified high/medium-worthiness factual claims (extract_claims; opinions and predictions skipped; max 3 per response). A ready-to-send request for this claim (optional, paid separately): Quick check ($0.15) from extract_claims, Deep verify from check_answer and quick_check. extract_claims adds alternatives[] with ready-to-send Quick check ($0.15), Deep verify ($0.75) and Verify claim ($1.00) requests.
